static_validation.budget: ChooseWideFullYRows includes kWideBf16ReducePhaseBytes in its work-bank skew estimate; the additional 32B is accounted for.
static_validation.scope: Only the BF16 wide-path reduction phase changes; other dtypes and paths are unaffected.
